university_name: Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin
requirement_text: Non-EU minimum academic requirement bands (varies by course): "A Levels: A*A*A to ABB, depending on the course... The six subjects must include a grade of 4 or C in English and a grade of 4 or C in Mathematics and a grade of 4 or C in a language other than English." "IB: 30–40 points (including bonus points), depending on the course. 3 subjects at grade 5 Higher Level and 3 subjects at grade 4 Standard Level, including English, Mathematics and a language." "US Curriculum: Unweighted GPA 3.2–3.5/4.0 and SAT 1250 to 1400 (500 min in each session - no essay required) or ACT 27 to 32 (cumulative, without writing), depending on the course."

university_name: Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin
requirement_text: Non-EU English Language Requirement -- accepted via qualifying secondary exam: "Irish Leaving Certificate: a grade 6 or better in ordinary level English", "GCSE: a grade C/5 or better in English language", "US High School: a grade C in English taken in final year", "International Baccalaureate: English A1, A2 or B: SL4 if presenting IB through English, HL5 if presenting through French or Spanish." Or via international standardised test: "IELTS (academic or indicator): 6.5 (6 in each band)", "Duolingo English Test: minimum overall score of 120/160 (100 in each subscore)", "TOEFL iBT: 90 overall (21 in each section)", "Cambridge Advanced/Proficiency: 180 overall (no score below 170)", "Pearson Test of English (Academic): a minimum score of 69 (59 in each section)." "Some programmes (e.g. Dental programmes and Clinical Speech and Language Studies) have higher requirements."

university_name: Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin
requirement_text: Medicine and Dental Science are marked "S" (Special) rather than a numbered band in Table 1, and Table 4 lists Medicine's science-subject requirement as "Group C 1, Group C 2" with a footnote: "Applicants who do not have some qualification in Physics must have Mathematics at Level 4." Non-EU Medicine applicants are separately required to sit an admissions test (referenced elsewhere on tcd.ie as HPAT-Ireland for EU/CAO Medicine entry); the non-EU guide does not fully detail the non-EU-specific test process in the pages captured.

university_name: Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin
requirement_text: Additional requirements by programme (Table 5): "All programmes" require the "English Language Requirement, Age Requirement." Programme-specific extras: Medicine, General Nursing, Dental programmes, Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Radiation Therapy, Social Studies (Social Work) require "Garda Vetting, Health Screening, Fitness to Practice"; Engineering programmes and Psychology require "Fitness to Practice" only; Human Nutrition & Dietetics and Music Education require "Garda Vetting" only. Age requirement: "Applicants seeking admission in 2026 must have a date of birth before 15th January 2010."
